what_this_is: The index-calculus baseline ledger (the ratchet). For each curve and size, the current best verified IC pipeline with its protocol, receipts and end-to-end S, and its distance to the matched rho and to Bernstein-Lange. One row, one experiment: no row combines numbers from two experiments. Human view: BASELINES.md.
rule: AGENTS.md, 'Success criterion: iterative improvement of the index-calculus baseline' (owner, 2026-10-15; cryptanalysis#919, crypto#1908). Every verified, measured improvement over a baseline row is a success; a landed improvement replaces the row and the old row moves to ratchet_history with its delta. The gap to rho is the distance remaining, not a gate.

conventions.gap_direction: Every gap is IC cost over the reference's cost, so a value above 1 is the distance still to close and a value below 1 means the IC is cheaper on that boundary. The sources' own 'online speedup' (rho over IC) is the reciprocal; it is kept in each row's source_figure.
conventions.S: S = cost / sqrt(r) in the unit named on the row. The unit differs between experiments (a batched affine addition in crypto's ic price; a rho step of the run's tuned rho at n=83; a rho group operation of CPU at n=19). S values compare inside a row only; the gap ratios carry no unit.
conventions.cold: Every phase for one fresh target with empty caches: reusable setup (factor base, relations, linear algebra / log table, index) plus the online interval. A row whose experiment did not charge a phase names it (n=83: uncharged_phases, factor-base construction); such a cold S is a lower bound and its ratios are not every-phase figures. A row measured in wall time on one host says so (n=83: headline_scope).
conventions.online: From the first target-dependent operation to the verified scalar, reusable setup excluded (AGENTS.md, 'The default IC objective is one target').
conventions.setup: s_ic_setup = s_ic_cold - s_ic_online on every row that carries it: the reusable work for the first target that the row's experiment charged, the relation-collection / rank stage and the linear algebra (or the verified load of its cached factor-log table) included, less every phase the row names in uncharged_phases. It is all reusable work only on a row without uncharged_phases: n=41, 53 and 61 (crypto rule v3, whose setup includes factor-base selection and build, relation collection, linear algebra and the descent's solver). Both n=83 rows exclude factor-base construction (each process loads the K600 base from a file); B's n=83 row (other_records) also excludes its linear algebra (51.3 ms) and setup input control (32.3 ms). n=19 carries no s_ic_setup. It never means setup without the rank stage. Where an experiment times the rank stage separately (n=83), the row may also split s_ic_setup into s_ic_rank_stage + s_ic_setup_without_rank_stage, in the row's own unit; the split is optional, s_ic_setup is not. Corrected 2026-10-16, see corrections.
conventions.intervals: 95% bootstrap over targets unless the row says otherwise. Inverting a ratio of means inverts its interval endpoints exactly.
conventions.evidence_tiers: Tier 0 / Tier 1 as in AGENTS.md 'CPU performance evidence tiers'. 'crypto isolated_bench container' means one cloud container through crypto's isolation tool (pinned CPU, PSI gate, contended runs re-run), without a provider allocation receipt: it is neither Tier 0 nor Tier 1 here. 'exploratory' has no pinned CPU or allocation receipt.
conventions.tuned_rho: 'Tuned rho' means A's tuned StrongRhoG worker rT770 (Fold field kernel, 64 lanes, DP 6, escape off; crypto 770f6a69 examples/n83_rho_optimization_eval.rs with research/n83_evaluation_20261012/optimization/selected_config.json), the fastest correct n=83 reference found by experiments/koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014. It has been run at n=83 only. ParallelRho (crypto ic price) is crypto's own 'tuned signed-Frobenius walk' (64 lanes in lockstep); it is reported where it is the matched rho, and it is not rT770.

baselines.section_5a_band: Not computable from this run. The IC arms emit rank-stage probes and root calls, online probes and stored states, but no group additions, scalar multiplications, canonicalizations, fold rotations or index inserts, so the unpriced native work cannot be priced at 0, 0.1 and 1 GAE per operation and the IC / rho gap (4.416) has no band. The gap holds as a wall-time figure on this one host only.
baselines.replication: The run is itself a Tier 1 repeated-alternating-pair measurement (36 pairs; see tier1_qualification). Not replayed on another host class. verify_receipt.py reproduces result.json and result_table.md byte for byte on a copy of the whole receipt directory, and the gates make every relation, per-attempt probe count, root call and counter equal across kM38IB and kM38IC with the index layout equal to the frozen one, but no second host class has timed the round-2 arm. The saving is field-arithmetic and insert-loop wall time, which depends on the host (this run's AVX-512-exposing Intel host gave 1.2574 on the build, the design's local model 1.37), so the same caution applies to the 1.1169.
